description: SOF faction name -> mesh material layer per cosmetic slot. Index = cosmetic slot by position (slotNames: 1 primary_nanocoating, 2 secondary_nanocoating, 3 tertiary_nanocoating, 4 tech_area), value = the mesh material layer (material1-4) that slot's component feeds. The pattern material slots are not faction-dependent: slot 6 always feeds patternMaterial1 and slot 8 patternMaterial2. No source table carries this conversion - it is curated per-faction data, validated at build time.
